key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline mapped the chain as stocks/flows/delays plus the inventory-correction and information loops and named the leverage (rule and information flow, not the factory) at first sight, while the non-routed v5 AI opened sympathetic to the CEO's capacity frame and rejected the $2M flexible-production CAPEX only after the variance-ratio gate — correct, but one structural pass late (v5: human 37.5/40, AI 36/40). The routed run closed both gaps as contract outputs: structure-first scan at WHAT (loop map, delay inertia), the m048 completion contract (bullwhip check with multiplier 1 + 2L/p + 2L^2/p^2 = 5 / 1.625; echelon variance trace 100 → 500 → 2,500 → 12,500 with the distributor's '5x' explained at echelon 1; policy lever = decision rule, not capacity — CAPEX absorbs but does not remove manufactured variance), plus falsifiable observable (factory order variance must fall toward ≤ 500/~162 after the rule fix), local-data-first (model reproduces observed distributor sigma 50 before predicting), and cheap-fix-as-decisive-experiment (the ~$50-100k rule change discriminates the compounding model; the $2M CAPEX is the expensive experiment). m044's stakeholder provenance re-framed the CAPEX as an interested-party solution pre-arithmetic and surfaced the hidden requirement (a visible sigma 112 → ~13 story plus a deferral path, not a refusal). Residual shared gap: cross-echelon compounding is approximate under serial correlation — both sides flag simulation verification, neither runs it in-trace.
learning_signal: On supply/decide signatures with a volatility complaint and a capacity proposal, the bullwhip is manufactured by the decision rule and the information flow, not by demand or production: before any capacity investment, compute the variance multiplier of the governing ordering rule (1 + 2L/p + 2L^2/p^2) and trace variance through every echelon (100 → 500 → 2,500 → 12,500); a downstream 'demand is 5x more volatile' claim is explained at the first echelon, before production exists. The leverage hierarchy is rule/parameter > information flow > capacity: information sharing (all echelons forecast end-customer demand) and forecast smoothing (p=4, multiplier 5 → 1.625) beat capacity additions by ~9x on sigma because capacity absorbs variance without removing its source; a capacity proposal on this signature is an interested-party frame whose arithmetic must be demanded before discussion. Every systems-style pass on this family must output the falsifiable observable and the cheap-fix-as-decisive-experiment so the fix is verified, not asserted.
suggested_improvement: Keep m044+m048 dual-route on this signature (router confident=no, gap 0); the m048/m011 contract gains: structure-first scan at WHAT entry, echelon variance trace with the 'first-echelon explains the complaint' check, leverage-hierarchy statement (rule > information > capacity) with the CAPEX-absorbs-but-does-not-remove line, falsifiable observable, and cheap-fix-as-decisive-experiment — all standing items, not REVIEW afterthoughts. Make interested-party provenance (P1) of any capacity proposal a mandatory packet line on supply-chain variance signatures; retain m011 as corroborating scan context and P8 fast path when the case is fully specified.

key_gap: vs baseline: the pure style over-modeled (registry weakness 'data-hungry, over-modeling'): it mapped the store→DC→supplier chain, requested 12 weeks of POS data, simulated an order-up-to model, and prescribed a 3-4 week safety-stock/reorder-optimization/S&OP program for a visible 5-minute cause — reorder qty 40 vs 400, changed 14 days ago (exactly the onset window), deficit 400 − 40 = 360/day matching the OOS exactly, manager's day-1 log reading 'check reorder qty', DC 99.7% fill ruling out upstream in one line, flat POS ruling out demand. The human's own simulation reproduced the OOS only with 'effective supply ~40/day' — the parameter screen it never opened (v5: human 16/40, AI 36/40). The non-routed v5 AI already won this case with cheap-checks-first triage; the routed run held the win and hardened it: m091 chunking made the onset-audit + one-line falsifications first-class; the m003 inversion gate (R4, guarantee goal) priced 8 ranked failure modes of the systemic program BEFORE DO (reorder optimization inherits Q=40; safety stock sized on the wrong effective supply; $650/day bleed; program metric — fill rate — unchanged by definition); m020 pre-mortem priced the program's no-mechanism-touches-the-parameter failure branch; restore-as-decisive-experiment named the 5-minute fix as the cheapest discriminator; tempo mode (P2, deadline) committed at DO. Residual gap shared with both baselines: why the parameter changed remains un-mitigated (no change control) — the v6 run names it as the explicit process follow-on.
learning_signal: On decide/guarantee + deadline signatures with a sharp-onset deficit, the onset-window audit + two one-line falsifications (fill rate, demand stability) + exact arithmetic (400 − 40 = 360/day) outrank the full chain model: a deficit that (a) matches the onset window (a setting changed 14 days ago), (b) is arithmetically explained by a single parameter, and (c) has upstream/demand causes ruled out in one line each, has the parameter restore AS the fix — and any honest chain model needs that same parameter in its calibration ('effective supply ~40/day' IS the parameter screen). Structural programs (safety stock, reorder optimization, S&OP, collaborative forecasting) are justified only after cheap checks fail; before proposing one, invert it (≥6 ranked failure modes — the program inherits the corrupted rule and has no mechanism touching it) and price its failure branch (weeks of bleed, unchanged metric). The cheap restore is also the decisive experiment: if the deficit were not from the parameter, the OOS would not end within ~1 day.
suggested_improvement: The trap-avoidance is installed (router keeps the systems style out of top-3 on this signature — m048 never routed; the NEG lesson is live). Keep m003 inversion as the standing gate whenever a data-hungry program is proposed against a visible local cause with a guarantee goal; add restore-as-decisive-experiment to the cheap-fix completion contract (m091 chunking), and generalize the onset-window cheap-checks-first triage as a WHAT-stage item on any anomaly diagnosis; add change-control/4-eyes on parameter edits as the standing follow-on process item so the residual is closed by process, not by the next model.
